test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Obscure
solution: The correct answer is '**Clear**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Obscure**' is '**Clear**'. • **Obscure**: not easy to see or understand. (जो आसानी से दिखाई न पड़े या समझ में न आए, धुँधला या दुर्बोध) • *Example: For some **obscure** reason, he decided to give up his well-paid job, to become a writer.* • **Clear**: easy to see, hear or understand. (देखने, सुनने या समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट, साफ़) • *Example: His voice wasn’t very **clear** on the telephone.* **Correct Answer:__** *Clear.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Vague**: not clear or definite. (अस्‍पष्‍ट या अनिश्‍चित) • **Dim**: not bright or easy to see; not clear. (मंद, धुँधला, अस्‍पष्‍ट) • **Doubtful**: unlikely or uncertain. (संदिग्‍ध या अनिश्चित) 37:T52c, The correct answer is** 'Very neat and clean'.**
